```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti, aes(x = `Alt(m)`, y = `HSA(%)`, color = Hab)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Altitude (m)",
    y = "HSA(%)",
    color = "Habitat",
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti, aes(x = Enr, y = `HSA(%)`)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Site",
    y = "HSA (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
Data_Globale_Tahiti <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(
    jours_enregistrement = as.numeric(
      difftime(Fin, Début, units = "days")
    )
  )
total_jours <- sum(Data_Globale_Tahiti$jours_enregistrement, na.rm = TRUE)

total_jours
```


```{r}
ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti, aes(x = `Alt(m)`, y = `N/E`, shape = Hab)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1 ), method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Altitude (m)",
    y = "N/E",
    shape = "Habitat"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti, aes(x = `HSA(%)`, y = `N/E`, shape = Hab)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "HSA (%)",
    y = "N/E",
    shape = "Habitat"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

summary(lmer(`N/E` ~ `Alt(m)` + (1|Commune), data = Data_Globale_Tahiti))
summary(lmer(`N/E` ~ `HSA(%)` + (1|Commune), data = Data_Globale_Tahiti))
```

```{r}
# Forcer l'ordre des habitats
Data_Globale_Tahiti$Hab <- factor(
  Data_Globale_Tahiti$Hab,
  levels = c("Urbain", "Suburbain", "Prairie", "Forêt")
)

# Graphique : boîte à moustaches + points + moyenne + SE
ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti,
       aes(x = Hab, y = `N/E`)) +
  
  # Boîte à moustaches
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Points par site
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # Moyenne
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Erreur standard (SE)
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Habitat",
    y = "Proportion d'espèces native (N/E)",
    title = "Proportion N/E par type d'habitat (sites, moyenne ± SE)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
library(emmeans)
mod_hab <-lmer(`N/E` ~ `Hab` + (1|Commune), data = Data_Globale_Tahiti)
summary(mod_hab)
car::Anova(mod_hab)
emmeans(mod_hab, pairwise ~ Hab)
emmeans(mod_hab, pairwise ~ Hab, adjust = "tukey")


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Créer une nouvelle variable regroupant les habitats
Data_Globale_Tahiti <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(
    Habitat_Group = case_when(
      Habitat %in% c("Urbain", "Suburbain") ~ "Urbain",
      Habitat %in% c("Forêt", "Prairie") ~ "Nature",
      TRUE ~ Habitat  # pour les autres éventuels
    )
  )

# Forcer l'ordre des groupes
Data_Globale_Tahiti$Habitat_Group <- factor(
  Data_Globale_Tahiti$Habitat_Group,
  levels = c("Urbain", "Nature")
)

# Graphique : boîte à moustaches + points + moyenne + SE
ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti,
       aes(x = Habitat_Group, y = `N/E`)) +
  
  # Boîte à moustaches
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Points par site
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # Moyenne
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Erreur standard (SE)
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Type d'habitat regroupé",
    y = "Proportion d'espèces native (N/E)",
    title = "Proportion N/E par habitat (Urbain vs Nature, sites, moyenne ± SE)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
summary(lm(`N/E` ~ `Habitat_Group`, data = Data_Globale_Tahiti))
```
```{r}


# Créer une variable pour 4 catégories de HSA
Data_Globale_Tahiti <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(
    HSA_Group = case_when(
      `HSA(%)` <= 0.10 ~ "≤ 10%",
      `HSA(%)` > 0.10 & `HSA(%)` <= 0.25 ~ "10–25%",
      `HSA(%)` > 0.25 & `HSA(%)` <= 0.50 ~ "25–50%",
      `HSA(%)` > 0.50 ~ "> 50%"
    )
  )

# Forcer l'ordre des catégories
Data_Globale_Tahiti$HSA_Group <- factor(
  Data_Globale_Tahiti$HSA_Group,
  levels = c("≤ 10%", "10–25%", "25–50%", "> 50%")
)

# Graphique : boîte à moustaches + points + moyenne + SE
ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti,
       aes(x = HSA_Group, y = `N/E`)) +
  
  # Boîte à moustaches
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Points par site
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # Moyenne
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Erreur standard (SE)
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Catégorie HSA (%)",
    y = "Proportion d'espèces native (N/E)",
    title = "Proportion N/E selon HSA (sites, moyenne ± SE)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()

summary(lm(`N/E` ~ `HSA_Group`, data = Data_Globale_Tahiti))
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

Data_Global_Long <- pivot_longer(Data_Globale_Tahiti,
                          cols = c(`Arb(%)`, `Arbu(%)`, `Her(%)`),
                          names_to = "Vegetation",
                          values_to = "Pourcentage")

ggplot(Data_Global_Long, aes(x = Hab, y = Pourcentage, fill = Vegetation)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15),
              size = 1, alpha = 0.5, color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_grey(start = 0.3, end = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal()
```
